info.title: Nexa API
info.description: Local API contract for secured identity, tenant/workspace administration, Catalog reads and Sales Client Accounts and Purchase Requests. Bearer authentication revalidates the persistent session; browser refresh and sign-out use the surface refresh cookie and Origin policy, while the explicit NATIVE transport uses a rotated opaque refresh-token header without weakening the browser Origin boundary. Sales Order conversion and lifecycle endpoints plus the tenant-scoped persisted change feed are included. Warehouse and Logistics HTTP workflows are included with FEFO, dispatch lifecycle and Proof of Delivery evidence. Business Documents, private object storage, invoice drafts, receivables and Stripe-compatible payment intents are included.
